# Security reporting

For a vulnerability in the Go implementation, report it privately to the maintainers of MoeDove-LLC/IXP-Manager. Include the affected commit or release and enough information to reproduce the issue with sample data. Private GitHub reports can be opened from the repository security page when enabled. [Repository security page](https://github.com/MoeDove-LLC/IXP-Manager/security)

The original PHP project's support and disclosure policy is available in its [historical snapshot](https://github.com/MoeDove-LLC/IXP-Manager/blob/8161e185b9a155f6b297f1487a2d0c6ed920e27e/.github/SECURITY.md).
